summary: Iteration 5 — review notifications side-effect + deep-link + immutable-history — verified end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_review_notifications.py (22 tests, 100% pass) covering: (a) each of the 5 review kinds (written, time_coded, coverage_response, rubric, status) spawns exactly one bell notification for the project owner with correct type/read/project_id/project_title/review_id/review_kind/author_name/deep_link fields, (b) per-kind copy matches spec ('left you a written note', '0:33', 'Scene 2', 'rubric evaluation', 'set Neon Heart\'s status to “approved”'), (c) GET /api/notifications is sorted desc by created_at and populates every extra field, (d) POST /notifications/{id}/read + cross-owner no-op, (e) POST /notifications/read-all bulk flips only the caller's rows (attacker's read-all leaves student notes unread), (f) cross-owner GET /notifications does not leak Aria's rows to a fresh registered student, (g) IMMUTABLE HISTORY: after posting 5 notifications the seeded rev-nh-1..5 rows remain intact, superseding a rubric preserves the old row with superseded_by set, and no field (kind/message/created_at) of a freshly created review is mutated by the notification side-effect, (h) iteration-3 regression: /api/projects/{pid}/reviews still returns seeded+new events with joined author names. Full iteration-4 security_authz suite re-run — 40/40 pass. Frontend UI verified with Playwright: bell badge shows correct unread count (5), popover opens with per-item review_kind · project_title · Open → footer and cyan pulse dot when unread, clicking an item marks read (badge 5 → 4), navigates to /reviews?project=<pid>&review=<rid>, the student-review-<rid> row is present with cyan highlight and scrolled into view, Mark-all-read clears every unread and the badge disappears.

issues: 'UNREAD NOTIFICATIONS' stat card (from GET /user/dashboard) stayed at 5 after mark-all-read while the bell badge correctly cleared to 0. The bell is source of truth so this is cosmetic only — either invalidate/refetch the dashboard summary when notifications change, or drive the card from the same polled state as the bell.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: refresh (or share state with) the dashboard 'Unread notifications' KPI card when the bell mark-all-read/mark-read fires — currently it lags until next dashboard refetch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1594 lines — please consider splitting into routers (auth, projects, sync_studio, rights, ai, faculty, notifications). Not blocking.

_spawn_review_notification is correctly wrapped in try/except at the call site so a broken notifications collection never blocks review persistence. Copy branching (status / time_coded / coverage_response) is clean and matches spec.
Notification model correctly uses Optional[...] for all new review fields — backward compatible with pre-iteration-5 rows.

POST /notifications/{id}/read is scoped by user_id in the update filter so cross-owner calls are silent no-ops (verified). Consider returning 404 instead of {ok:true} when no doc matched, so clients can distinguish 'marked' vs 'not yours' — minor DX nit, not a security issue.

Append-only invariant holds: only /faculty/projects/{pid}/reviews inserts new rows; supersede only sets superseded_by on the OLD row, never modifies message/kind/created_at. No delete_ calls on faculty_reviews anywhere in the codebase (grepped).

TID.topbarNotifications resolves to 'topbar-notifications-btn' — the review request said data-testid `topbar-notifications` for the bell. Not a real problem (the popover/badge/item testids match spec exactly), but worth aligning naming.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (badge, popover, per-item deep-link, highlight, mark-all-read, live focus refresh)
